body:
I think this is not a bug, looks like is done with `GraphNode`, in this case you need to manually do an action (hide ou delete the subwindow) when receive the `close_request` signal. 

About the `application/config/auto_accept_quit` this is for when the main windows receive the close notification automaticly finish the `MainLoop` (which also will close the program) so is expeted don't affect the subwindows.

Now i thing i noticed is the sub windows aren't receiving the `close_request` signal and the `NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST` when you press alt+f4 and `force_native` is `false`, i don't know if that is expected but looks strange for me.

Godot v4.4.dev4 - Windows 10.0.19045 - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 580 2048SP (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 31.0.21921.1000) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)
